To the article: I really don't have much of a grip on what's going here. The minimalist style is not helped by the fact that the writing in general lacks sophistication and fails to convey any real sense of emotional space for me. E.g.

He knew the danger he was in.

He knew that the entity could kill him instantly, if he blinked.

But he wasn't afraid.

That middle bit is teeerrible. 'Entity,' 'instantly, 'if he blinked' feel so awkward and out of touch with the two lines preceding and succeeding it that it completely pulls me out of whatever a steadily building effect. And there's lines like this all over the piece:

He slowly lowered his eyelid

Roughly as large as him

And Traces of Kylon brand spray paint

etc.

Beyond the writing the plot was just totally lost on me. It seems like a back and forth but I can't tell which parts are the back and the forth. I think this work leagues better in a monologue, rather than - this. It's very bizarre and it was not so in an enjoyable way for me, as it doesn't characterize 173 at all beyond 'he's sad and does not to murderdeath this man because says he is sorry.' I can't fault it for lack of ambition but overall this just did not work, in mine own humbly opinion.
